mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (name, grade_tag_id, memo) VALUES (#{name}, #{gradeTagId}, #{memo})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.grade_tag_id, t.tag_value AS grade_name, s.memo, s.created_at FROM student s LEFT JOIN tag t ON s.grade_tag_id = t.id ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC
SELECT s.id, s.name, s.grade_tag_id, t.tag_value AS grade_name, s.memo, s.created_at FROM student s LEFT JOIN tag t ON s.grade_tag_id = t.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
